data.narrative:
Stardust Solutions is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Yanai Yedvab that has raised $75M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), including later-stage companies such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. A narrow peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum sample thresholds.

The Stage-Progression method, which applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A advancement, was the applicable triangulation technique. Using the company's $75M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying the standard step-up multiplier yields an implied valuation of $150M. This method captures the expected capital increase and dilution dynamics associated with progression to the subsequent funding round.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $128M to $172M, with a median point of $150M. This range reflects reasonable upside and downside variance around the stage-based estimate. Key uncertainties include the absence of contemporaneous private comparables at the same stage and valuation tier, which limits external validation of the 2.0x multiplier in this specific sector. Any material divergence in burn rate, revenue traction, or market conditions versus sectoral norms would warrant reassessment of the step-up multiple applied.
